description: Resolve any ticker and see its price in USD and EUR in one command — stocks, crypto, and forex, no API key.

novel_features.name: Multi-currency quote
novel_features.description: See any ticker's last price in its native currency, USD, and EUR in a single command.

novel_features.name: TradingView-rate conversion
novel_features.description: Convert an amount between currencies using TradingView's own live forex rates.

novel_features.name: Local watchlist
novel_features.description: Track a list of symbols locally and snapshot their USD/EUR quotes to SQLite for offline querying.

novel_features.name: Snapshot drift
novel_features.description: Show how each watched symbol moved in USD between its two most recent snapshots.
